subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: What exact provider-reported cost metadata contract should OpenClaw expose for OpenRouter responses, and which runtime/session surfaces should consume it?
rationale: The remaining work changes public runtime/session semantics and cost precedence, so implementation should not guess whether exact OpenRouter charges, local estimates, or broader ledger APIs own the canonical field.

options.title: Add exact-cost metadata contract
options.body: Expose provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, and raw details while keeping existing local estimates as fallback.

options.title: Defer to broader usage API
options.body: Keep this issue open until a shared per-call usage ledger or `session_status` usage API defines the common contract for all providers.

options.title: Keep exact costs outside core
options.body: Leave core on estimate-only fields and route OpenRouter exact billing to a plugin or external accounting surface.

recommendation.title: Add exact-cost metadata contract
recommendation.body: Expose provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, and raw details while keeping existing local estimates as fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-history owner for OpenRouter billed-cost reconciliation and adjacent session/runtime usage surfaces.
